cast.name: Green sea turtle
cast.reference: A scientifically recognizable adult green sea turtle: broad oval olive shell with subtle scute pattern, pale underside, small dark eyes, four broad paddle-shaped flippers, realistic proportions and calm marine movement. No markings, accessories, or anthropomorphism.
